# Step0

**Done when:** The game shows on the 3D screen at 30+ fps for a recorded session and the result is written to the run sheet.

## One-time setup

**You:** Install the pinned SpidyVR 0.3.8 and WiVRn 26.9 headset app; connect Quest 2 over USB.

**You:** Set the Steam launch option exactly as follows (a system Flatpak uses /var/lib/flatpak/app/io.github.wivrn.wivrn): PRESSURE_VESSEL_IMPORT_OPENXR_1_RUNTIMES=1 PRESSURE_VESSEL_FILESYSTEMS_RW={home}/.local/share/flatpak/app/io.github.wivrn.wivrn STEAM_COMPAT_LAUNCHER_SERVICE=proton MANGOHUD=1 MANGOHUD_CONFIG=output_folder={state}/mangohud,autostart_log=30,log_duration=120 %command%

## Each run, in this order

**Script:** Create MangoHud output directory.

```sh
mkdir -p '{state}/mangohud'
```

**Script:** Start WiVRn server.

```sh
flatpak run io.github.wivrn.wivrn --early-active-runtime --no-publish-service
```

**Script:** Reverse WiVRn TCP port.

```sh
adb reverse tcp:9757 tcp:9757
```

**Script:** Launch the WiVRn headset app.

```sh
adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d wivrn+tcp://localhost org.meumeu.wivrn.github
```

**Script:** Launch SpidyVR through the helper.

```sh
env 'SPIDY_DIR={re_home}/spidy-0.3.8/Spidy-0.3.8' bash third_party/SpidyVR/tools/spidy-wivrn.sh
```

- [ ] Frame generation and vsync are off; RT reflections are off; aspect is Auto.

- [ ] VR VIEW is GAME SCREEN and GAME SCREEN 3D is at maximum.

- [ ] In the headset the screen shows depth.

- [ ] Turning the head does not steer the game camera.

- [ ] Menus and gameplay respond to the controller.

- [ ] Both eyes stay present without drops or crashes.

**You:** Record a session at 30+ fps.

## If it fails

| Symptom | Cause |
|---|---|
| Steam reports -51 | Check Proton and the WiVRn launch environment. |
| Proton session was not found | Launch the game from Steam with the required Proton service environment. |
| version is not supported | SpidyVR requires the supported game version 4.630.0.0. |
| Menus ignore controllers or one eye drops | Recheck controller focus and headset link stability. |
